title: A Gravity for the Terminal
author: Sebastian Crane
blurb: Cyrus Almeida, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
